Patients will be stratified by age (70 years or greater or less than 70), KPS (90 or 100 vs 70 or 80), MGMT promotor-methylation (yes or no), and IDH-mutation status (mutated or wild-type)

coder_notes: Only investigational agent is an autologous dendritic cell vaccine (excluded type). The placebo comparator is an autologous monocyte cell product; coded excluded_intervention_type under rule 0a (cell product) although it functions as the control. GM-CSF is admixed in both arms (adjuvant) and coded soc_backbone; no INN given in the record (sargramostim/molgramostim not specified). Temozolomide is standard chemoradiation/adjuvant therapy in all patients; bevacizumab and TTFields may be used per physician as second-line and are not listed. cns5_terminology historical because IDH-mutated glioblastoma is explicitly allowed (stratified as mutated or wild-type).
